purpose: Section 4.1: how much of the RMSE variation is attributable to method identity rather than to the choice of held-out engines

design_a.note: unbalanced design, split 7/8/9; interaction and seed are separate columns because each cell was replicated over seeds

shared_conclusion: method identity explains under 3% of the variance in both designs; the engine/validation-set choice explains 23-32%; the majority sits in the method-by-split interaction
interval_status: point estimates only: neither design replicates runs, so no interval is attached to the shares
